description: A nonempty first-order structure \(M\) satisfies \(T_{\forall}\) if and only if it embeds into some nonempty model of \(T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.model_universalPart_iff_embeds.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (T : L.Theory)
  (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.universalPart T ↔
    ∃ N x, ∃ (_ : Nonempty N), N ⊨ T ∧ Nonempty (L.Embedding M N)
